testcases.notes: Nightly runs the native TensorRT path and an independent Wan-AI/Wan2.2-TI2V-5B-Diffusers reference for the official 1280x704, 121-frame, 50-step, CFG 5, flow-shift 5, 24 FPS, seed-42 profile.
